response.description:
To support seamless migration and operation of workloads
that use large files including Azure VMware Solution (AVS) virtual machines
with large VMDK disks, Azure
NetApp Files now supports file sizes of up to 64 TiB for regular volumes. This enhancement
enables the migration of on‑premises workloads with large virtual machine disks
to Azure VMware Solution and supports ongoing operation of data‑intensive
workloads in Azure. The capability is available in all Azure
NetApp Files enabled regions across the Flexible, Standard, Premium,
and Ultra service levels.  Learn
more.
response.title: Generally Available: Support for workloads with large files in Azure NetApp Files
